items.title: Honeymoon trip to Soviet Union (1988)
items.summary: As mayor of Burlington, VT, Sanders led a sister-city delegation to Yaroslavl, USSR in 1988. At the time he praised some aspects of Soviet social programs. These statements are documented and publicly available.

sources.name: Politico
sources.description: Reporting on archived footage of Sanders's 1988 Yaroslavl sister-city trip

sources.name: CCTV Center for Media & Democracy
sources.description: Burlington government access recording of Sanders press conference upon return from Yaroslavl

items.title: Campaign staff wage dispute (2019)
items.summary: Field organizers on the 2020 Sanders presidential campaign publicly stated their effective hourly wage fell below $15/hr due to hours worked vs. salary paid — which conflicted with his $15 minimum wage position. The campaign subsequently raised pay.

sources.name: Washington Post
sources.description: Reporting on unionized field organizers' pay dispute

sources.name: Washington Post
sources.description: Sanders response; campaign limited hours so pay met $15/hr equivalent

note: Batch D 2026-07-22: 2 items on disk — 1 verified (Soviet 1988, Politico+CCTV), 1 alleged (2019 campaign wages, WaPo×2 = single outlet → not media-verified). Low count expected for this section (owner: least count-sensitive); no fabrication.
